# Build reliable services

This guide explains how teams build reliable services with clear configuration and safe deployment practices.

Use the installation steps first. Then review the configuration and API reference before you deploy the service to production.

## Operations

Monitor each service and document recovery steps. These practices help teams respond to failures without losing useful data.
